children: Benchmark Electronics Inc. (BHE) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 08, 2026.

On September 8, 2026, Benchmark Electronics, Inc. issued a press release announcing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.17 per share, payable on October 13, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/863436/000119312526385235/bhe-20260908.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/863436/000119312526385235/0001193125-26-385235-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
